notes.title: A glimpse into the Enemies in Zoria ⚔
notes.content:
[h2]Commanders![/h2]

Creating the world can be hard and complicated, but fortunately, to us it was also fun 😀 Today we wanted to offer you a glimpse into the [b]creatures you'll surely encounter[/b] while playing Zoria: Age of Shattering. While there is plenty to choose from, with fantasy classics such as skeletons, dragons or ghosts, we picked a bunch that we personally like the most, so it's kind of random 😂

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3a67eb1a74e69e6cdb246246b3068e4df5bdb1cb.png[/img][/td]
        [td]Let's start with the terrifying [b]Cave Claw Crawlers[/b]. As their name suggests, these grotesque creatures dwell in caves and other dark places. Their exoskeleton is a fortress of resilience, blending seamlessly into the darkness, making them masters of stealth and surprise. Armed with large, sharp blades, they are a force to be reckoned with, combining brute force with speed and agility.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/e2931ca688ef15d9f7830eceaef47986f798e8cc.png[/img][/td]
        [td]Next, we have the [b]Water Elementals[/b]. These entities, despite their aquatic namesake, are often found roaming the land. Their origin is a mystery, but it's believed they are born from concentrated magic energy, animating the prevailing element in their vicinity. They are solitary creatures, aggressively engaging in combat when approached. The older they are, the more powerful they become, making every encounter a thrilling challenge.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/fff2ee108cbecba5a65bcdbc9d019a654970c0e1.png[/img][/td]
        [td]Then there are the [b]Gargoyles[/b], magical constructs crafted by the wizards of old. At first glance, they may seem like ordinary statues, but get too close, and their true nature is revealed. These ancient guardians are carved from enchanted stone, and their cold, crystalline eyes gleam with an unnatural glow. They are fiercely loyal to their creators, and in battle, they channel their magical essence into devastating attacks.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/820049187fb01344f03adc28add125821860bd12.png[/img][/td]
        [td]Last but not least, we have the [b]Ancestor Guardians[/b]. These ancient creatures belong to the civilization of the Ancestors. Equipped with powerful weapons and armor, they are highly resilient and capable of dealing extensive damage with their magic attacks. They are sentient beings, capable of communicating in the common tongue, and are best avoided if possible.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Whether you're battling a Water Elemental or sneaking past a Cave Claw Crawler, make sure to stay alert and apply tactics! Now, gear up and prepare - Zoria: Age of Shattering launches on March 7, 2024!

Until next time,

notes.title: Major Improvements! 🤩 Monthly Changelog
notes.content:
[h2]Commanders! [/h2]

We're excited to share with you what's changed within this month in Zoria: Age of Shattering. We've implemented some elements you haven't seen before, as well as further improved features already in the game. Let's jump into it! 

[h2]⚔️ Speed Button During Encounter[/h2]
Say goodbye to long, drawn-out battles. With our new speed button, you can now control the pace of your encounters. This feature adds a new level of strategy and enjoyment to our turn-based combat system. Plus, we've added a handy marker on the turn queue, so you'll always know when the turn ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4e010c5757dff2727441915996a85a2051185731.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Combat Review[/h2]
Knowledge is power, and our new combat review feature gives you plenty of it. After each battle, you'll receive a summary, complete with EXP gained and any additional bonuses. And if you take on a new enemy, your journal will get updated with a new entry, which will be shown on-screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/e5e22fc466adc86cc10ad190fc8c4a7212c15e3e.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Partial Voice Over[/h2]
We implemented a partial voice over that really breathes life into our characters. Now, characters will say the beginning of their dialogue lines, which adds a new layer of depth and personality. Hearing the voices of characters complements the storytelling aspect of Zoria, and makes them more real and dynamic. Soon, we'll show you what the voice overs actually sound like, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/11e3f2a7a926854c14d3200d280454d89a58e0b2.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Map Improvements[/h2]
Navigation just got a whole lot easier. We added checkpoints to the map and made it more user-friendly, so you can focus on the adventure at hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be33dcff6215f8c0ff0fdae7910e3d4a8cbce136.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ UI Improvements[/h2]
Finding and managing your equipment now should be a breeze. We touched up the equipment tab for better usability - new items will now be clearly marked, so you'll never miss a new addition to your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/1f9e7c8675221ce9d43b96d7adf34cbfa979afbb.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Overall Quality Improvements[/h2]
We worked on the overall quality of graphics in Zoria. From on-screen fonts and effects to the look of characters in and outside of cutscenes - the edges are visibly sharper. We also improved the journal with quests, making it more readable and easier to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3b3c72cedbdc875812978321d74d419f9770b307.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed creating them. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you haven't already. Let's stay in touch! ⚔️

notes.title: Release Date and Price Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Commanders![/h2]

First off, a huge thank you for your patience and ongoing support. We're super excited to let you know that our much-anticipated game, [b]Zoria: Age of Shattering, is set to officially launch on March 7th, 2024[/b].

[previewyoutube=6-_NIf8ELl4;full][/previewyoutube]
Okay, so here's the situation. We're a team of three developers. We showed the demo to different gaming events, organized closed on-site playtests, listened to an external QA team and after gathering all this feedback we came to the conclusion that what we have isn't what we can hand over to you in the next month.

Zoria: Age of Shattering is an ambitious project, considering the scale of our team. We would say it's very ambitious, as we are reaching nearly 300k words in the game. An extensive story is great, but we also have a ready to-do list of things that require our work. [b]We can certainly confirm that the game is playable and we have achieved content-lock.[/b] However, the content itself is only half the success. [b]UX, your comfort of playing, and a great focus on eliminating as many bugs and blockers as possible is our priority at the moment. [/b]In short, we want to give you a game that we're proud of.

We believe that you understand the situation and that the additional weeks of waiting will be worth it. We have prepared 30+ hours of content for you, and the best is still waiting for the reveal!

Also, you have time to finish Baldur's Gate 3, there are no excuses in March! 😉

Since we gathered you here, we'll put all the cards out on the table and reveal the price as well. 
[b]Zoria: Age of Shattering will be available for purchase at $24.99.[/b]

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you haven't already. Let's stay in touch! ⚔️

However, our latest tests indicate that[b] the game will not meet our satisfaction level by October 5th.[/b] Therefore, we must delay the launch by a few weeks. 

We understand that this may be disappointing news, but we believe that taking this extra time to test and refine the game will ultimately result in a better experience for all of us. While most of these are minor, our small team of three people, including [b]one programmer handling most of the issues[/b] (poor Gabi), finds this number too significant to be sure that by October 5th, we will be able to deliver a game that we can confidently deem as a finished product.

[b]Therefore, our primary focus for the upcoming days will be intensive QA testing to determine precisely how many more weeks of additional bug fixing we require.[/b]

Ultimately, thorough testing is the key to delivering a game that meets your expectations and our high standards. We still need a bit more time to finalize the game and accurately determine a new release date. Stay tuned! We are doing our best to make it worth the wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/84ef4923c9e37789a0ed25de41382727c2000282.png[/img]

notes.title: Full release on October 5th. Monthly Changelog #7
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Commanders![/h1]

Before we get to the changelog, let's share with you the latest decision we made.

[h2]Important Announcement[/h2]

[b]Due to the congested September release schedule, we chose to delay the release date of Zoria.[/b] Titles such as Baldur's Gate 3, Starfield, and Lies of P, to name just a few, release around the same period. While some of you have pointed it out as we announced our release date, we couldn't put Zoria, an indie game, and other AAA production titles, in the same league (but thanks to those of you who did, we took it as a huge compliment!). Long story short, we feel that shifting our release date would give Zoria the attention and exposure it deserves.

That said, we settled that [b]October 5th[/b] will be the best day to release Zoria: Age of Shattering. It's just a few days later than our initial release date, but we believe this time will provide a space between releases needed for Zoria to shine through. ☀️ Additionally, since every single day at this point will be extremely precious, it will give us extra time to polish the game.

[h3]⚔️ Character Creator[/h3]
One of the significant improvements we've made in this category is [b]optimizing asset resource management[/b], which results in a lower memory footprint at runtime, ensuring smoother gameplay. 

We also [b]enhanced the customization options[/b]. Firstly, we improved support for colors, shader material modifications, and emissive materials. We even added a color picker! Secondly, we added a dynamic [b]size and scale control of the human body[/b]. Thanks to that feature, you'll be able to adjust body proportions and create different shapes of faces, making each character one-of-a-kind.

Furthermore, we implemented a wide array of styling features, such as various[b] hairstyles, faces, makeup options, eyebrows, facial hair[/b], etc., to ensure characters will come in a wide variety. Lastly, we incorporated numerous [b]new item models[/b] that can be used for character design, providing even more customization options.

We developed a useful tool for creating icons for in-game items. We're using it to create icons for all weapons and armor pieces in the inventory. We plan on using it to create portraits for heroes made with Character Creator as well, but we're still working on that 😉

notes.title: Changing plans
notes.content:
[h1]Adventurers! ⚔️ [/h1]

After careful consideration, we came to the conclusion that Zoria doesn't need Early Access, because we're ready to [b]make a Full Release this September. [/b]

Let's fill you in on which arguments helped us make this decision. 


[h2]Content Evaluation [/h2]

We've been working on Zoria tirelessly for some time now. There are surely creators among you that know the feeling (or rather a need) of polishing your project until you think it's perfect. The truth is, the inner critic might never tell you you got there 😉 

We evaluated our latest milestone and realized that [b]Zoria is so close to being completed that putting it on Early Access would only water down our progress[/b]. Launching Zoria in EA would mean launching an incomplete game for a few months when in reality, [b]we only need a few months to finish the game. [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/93b2744ee1ed307e222291c099b6dc51acc2e8b5.png[/img]
[i]Can be treated as a metaphor for us being close to finishing the game. Also, a nice screenshot.[/i]


[h2]Zoria is not that type of game [/h2]

Early Access has its benefits, don't get us wrong - that's why we considered it in the first place. Zoria has been in development for some time now, and we were eager to finally show it to you. But games that benefit from EA are hugely the ones that provide [b]service[/b]. From the very beginning, [b]we designed Zoria to be a complete, single-player adventure. [/b]We want you to be able to fully immerse yourself in the fantasy world of Zoria without the need to turn a blind eye to unpolished elements.  

And finally, the argument that appealed to us the most. 


[h2]Delivering Full Release sooner [/h2]

By launching Zoria in Early Access, we'd need to change our focus from finishing the game to hotfixing and bugfixing. Instead, we can stay on track and instead [b]release the game sooner[/b]. In fact, we made an honest calculation and decided that [b][u]Zoria: Age of Shattering will launch on September 19th, 2023.[/u]  [/b]

We got excited to get your reactions and feedback to Zoria ASAP, as it'd be an[b] invaluable source of information and a boost of encouragement.[/b] But you can still do that by following us on Twitter and Facebook or joining our Discord server ⚔️ At the end of the day, we're working with playtesters as well as with members of our wonderful community (thank you!) to make [b]the most magical experience possible. Rithvale had a complete makeover. We needed to rebuild it to match it with our current level of quality. Rithvale will become your homebase and your safe haven you'll long for after a long journey. 

Players will now have quests available (both sidequests and main quests), making it a more[b] lively area worth revisiting at different stages of the game. [/b]

notes.title: Dev Diary #8 - Characters, classes and team composition
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome, travelers of the Uram continent! [/h2]

I have gathered you here today to tell you about your upcoming duties and the companions with whom you will [b]undertake them. [/b]The times are hard, and the quest is challenging, so you must be extremely cautious when selecting [b]who you will befriend. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/b4bb1e1cb8f902e28f0f2142ee67e24ed6283b97.png[/img]

In Zoria,[b] ten different specializations[/b] of warriors may join our team. You, as a commander, will be out of this category, serving more as a [b]support but in a unique way[/b]. Two characters will represent each class with their [b]own story, motivations, and wits. [/b]

Your followers are critical to the success of your mission. Whether recruited through the Inn or from various quests, your companions represent your [b]most significant investment and resource[/b] since your adventure is squad-based, and only good use of the squad system can ensure success.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BtVnXc3/r4.png[/img]

For most of the exploration, you will [b]control the main character in real time[/b], with the squad following every step you take. However, during the combat, every character will be[b] ready to carry out your order.[/b]

Let's have a closer look at some of the classes in Zoria. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4a0178d27ed54a2ccbda304efa855cea208a154d.png[/img]

In addition to the above, the game will also include the following:
[list]
[b][*]Ranger
[*]Thief
[*]Wizard
[*]Priest
[*]Bard
[*]Nightwarden[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Team composition[/h2]
As you've probably already guessed, [b]only a good combination[/b] of your companions' classes can bring success on the battlefield. A team of rangers alone would be spectacular and look great on defensive walls, while their effectiveness would be [b]very low in a close encounter. [/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JQ6Nc51/ezgif-com-gif-maker.gif[/img]

There is another reason why you should be especially careful in choosing teammates. In the world of Zoria, there are objects that only a [b]character with the right abilities can interact with[/b]. Hence, [b]Battle Clerics can interact with Shrines of Nerdalye [/b]to replenish the party's health, and Wizard can [b]create magical bridges[/b] over which the whole team can safely cross to the other side.  

------------------

Concluding my story, I hope it has made you look forward to Zoria even more.[b] The year 2023 is very close[/b], and in a few months, you will see the result of our dream to create a full-blooded RPG. In the meantime, we wish you a [b]peaceful holiday and a happy new year!

notes.title: What's new in the world of Zoria? Monthly changelog.
notes.content:
Hello commanders! 

It's been almost a month and a half since our Kickstarter, and during this time, [b]we're working up a sweat to deliver the game that will give you a ton of fun.[/b] We want to introduce you to what we are currently developing and show you some new screenshots. We hope you enjoy them and whet your appetite for more! 

But before we get to the main course, we'd like to ask you to vote for Zoria in IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll. There are many of you out there, and we believe that together we will rank high in this competition for indie game lovers. 

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/070d9a93bf60633e767eed8a809110243b4bbfd7.jpg[/img][/url]

You can cast a vote on our IndieDB page [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering]>>here<< [/url]

[b]Now, let's move on with the changelog.[/b]

[b][h3]Nightwarden Class[/h3][/b]
As some of you may recall, one of the secret goals of the Kickstarter campaign was reaching 50%, and it unlocked a new class - [b]fearless and violent Nightwarden[/b]. First, we had some rough ideas on how this class should act on the battlefield, and during the last month, we managed to finish the profile of this class.

Nightwardens [b]will use fire [/b]on the battlefield because this is the most effective deterring of monsters. Having Nightwarden in your team will significantly increase the group morale, as [b]Nightwardens fear no death[/b] and can teach their teammates how to act the same. On top of that, Nightwardens know that the night is short; therefore, [b]they must act quickly. [/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Tbwhbsn/Sequence-01.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Day-night cycle[/h3][/b]
Well, what would be the point of the existence of Nightwardens if there were no night, wasn't it? That's why we've been spending the last few weeks polishing the day and night cycle in the world of Zoria, which will not only limit the amount of sunlight but also [b]affect certain events and behaviors at specific times of the day.[/b] 

And remember, the world of Zoria is not a safe enough place during the day. I dread to think how it will be at night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/93915a48baa4f2479e17f23caf1e3c518aa83b44.png[/img]

[b][h3]Lake Mannor[/h3][/b]
A castle in the middle of rocky mountains, a fisherman's hut, fog hovering over the lake, and rumors of a secret lurking beneath the surface of this reservoir. [b]Don't forget to chat with a hunter [/b]who stays in the area, as he will have something to say about the place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be8af7db7561bac19c67085c8531cdf6aea06404.png[/img]

[b][h3]New enemy - Troll[/h3][/b]
What is it - it has two legs, pointy ears, smells horrible, and you wouldn't entrust your pet to its care? No, it's not a green-clad boy rescuing a princess. [b]It's a nasty troll lurking for fresh meat, [/b]inattentively straying near his lair. Just look at this monstrosity. It's probably time to show him that treating poor animals like this doesn't seem right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d82af1487ef059090674bc53069b9c4c76b038c5.png[/img]

That's all for today, and we're back to making the game. Let us know what you think of the above features, and don't forget to join our Discord - it's a smug place for RPG & coffee lovers (but if you are more of a tea person, you are more than welcome too.)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/

Stay tuned,
Zoria Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #6 - Religion
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ansharpublishing/zoria-age-of-shattering][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/34298a2a31aa42ec44dd612837a81cbd9a1669f6.jpg[/img][/url]

Hey everyone!

[h3]Zoria lore is huge! Today we want to focus on the topic of religion, which, of course, is present in the game's world.[/h3]

We believe it will be interesting to talk more about this; religion is important to us as people, therefore why not dig into this a little bit? There are three main churches:
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/393575351fb4f653c731ce316cff27f028c4b9f7.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]1. The Church of Torath, also known as The Church Zoria’s Light[/h1]

Generally, Monotheistic, with smaller figures involved in the mythos, established religion within Elion and extended with varying influence into most of the Uram continent.

[b]Gods[/b]:

- [b]Torath [/b]- God of Light, believed to carry the sun on his back across the sky and responsible for bringing light, heat, and general well-being to the citizen of Zoria.

- [b]Torhuz[/b] – God-like figure, brother of Torath and polar opposite. Believed to dwell in the depths of the night and fight an eternal battle with Torath for control of the skies.

With the dual-moon specific of Zoria, two eclipses are happening, one incomplete and one that completely covers the sun, believed to be instances of a great war between the two brothers and bad omens for the people.
 The stars are believed to be spirits sent by Torath to light the night sky and prevent Torhuz from bringing eternal darkness to the world.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/a74f4fed9dae3b756176997126b3c3a88d983d7d.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]2. The Church of the 9 Gods[/h1]

Polytheistic, widespread throughout the Uram continent. Based on ancient humanoid gods said to inhabit Vrukmanar, the volcanic landmass east of Uram.

[b]Gods[/b]:

[b]Athys [/b]- Goddess of Light, governor and chief of all gods (patron saint of Priests and Battle Clerics)

[b]Dhases [/b]- God of Prosperity (patron saint of Bards, Merchants, and Traders)

[b]Garom[/b]- God of War and Fire(patron saint of Mercenaries Battle Clerics and Lancers)

[b]Amaldir[/b] - God of Earth and Nature, Husband of Mei-Devi(patron saint of Rangers, Farmers, Commoners, and Hunters)

[b]Niala[/b] - Goddess of Magic and Dance (patron saint of Wizards and Mages < Difference between the two would be that Wizard is MALE only name for the magic practitioner, while Sorceress is the FEMALE equivalent. Mage is Neutral; both males and females can use this term to identify themselves as magic practitioners.

[b]Thedara [/b]- Goddess of Protection and Constructions, daughter of Athys and Chaos (patron saint of Sentinels and Kingsmen)

[b]Mei-Devi[/b] - Goddess of Patience, the Waters and the Night, sister of Han-Jhora (patron saint of Thiefs and  Sailors)

[b]Mira[/b] - Goddess of Passion and Love (patron saint of Bard)

[b]Han-Jhora[/b] - God of the Dead and Ruler of the Underworld, brother of Mei-Devi 
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/af8e6b2a834c526531a5170de73d23b982379818.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]3. The Temple of Karne[/h1]

Animist religion is based on the belief that all living creatures and even inanimate objects are inhabited by the spirit of Zoria, a spirit that is responsible for all the magic within the world.

Which church would you join? Subjectively, [b]The Temple of Karne[/b] speaks to us very loudly!

Until the next time!
Team Zoria

notes.title: Dev Diary #5 – Combat in Zoria
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ansharpublishing/zoria-age-of-shattering][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/34298a2a31aa42ec44dd612837a81cbd9a1669f6.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Hello commanders![/b]

In today's Dev Diary, we'll cover what many tactical RPG fans like best: [b]combat[/b]. We designed it to be dynamic, fluid, and inviting to engage. But how did we achieve that? Enjoy the read below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/27b347415b632a8ddfef6af94b31a65707dbeb07.jpg[/img]

[h1]Classes[/h1]

In your team, you will have characters of different classes, each of which will have a [b]tree of 16 skills[/b], from which you will choose 9, giving you the chance to [b]try other builds and tactics[/b]. For example, the Wizard class can pick all the water-based spells, fire-based spells, or a mix of them. The same Wizard class can follow the route of [b]AoE or single target damage or favor a more protection-oriented build[/b].

Abilities vary from [b]single target to effect over time and area of effect[/b]. Some include [b]summoning, spawning area-of-effect items on the battlefield, or using line-of-sight and blocking enemies' paths.[/b]

Your protagonist, the Commander, Andar Witherell, is a special class on its own and can either go the route of [b]damage dealer, shield buffer, or healer, with a lot of flexibility in its skills[/b].

When completing a team, the critical thing to pay attention to is [b]class synergy[/b]. Classes can protect, heal, or empower other characters, and creative use of special abilities (taunts and control) can provide [b]exciting encounters[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/b6350ef01fa51013dd93247e80ffd9cea592f911.jpg[/img]

[h1]Resources[/h1]

There are several combat-specific resources: Action Points, Focus, and Mana/Energy.

[b]Action Points[/b]: Each character or enemy character has two Action Points. You can use these points for moving (both APs), moving and abilities use (1AP + 1AP), or if in a favorable position, abilities only (2APs). Remember that some high-impact abilities cost more than others and have a 2AP cost.

[b]Focus[/b]: Each class generates Focus by using other abilities or by the use of a potion. Focus is always 0 at the beginning of combat and can reach a maximum of 100.

[b]Mana/Energy[/b]: This set of resources is directly connected to the Intellect and Agility stats and can be replenished by resting or using potions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/a56c398b9e41ba6d919c54e0aaf0c38978c4af32.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battlefield[/h1]

Zoria is[b] not using a traditional grid-based system[/b], thus making the combat a bit more fluid. You will still have battlefield obstacles that can hinder you or your enemy.

When observing the environment during the battle, you need to pay attention to [b]using line-of-sight[/b] - your character cannot fire while another party member or enemy is in front of him. The same is true for the enemies - they will move into position to attack a character if they are out of sight. Also, initiating combat near an [b]environment trap[/b] can lead to the creative use of such traps to aid in battle.

But, even if the scales of victory start tipping to you, you can't be sure of your success. The combat is turn-based, but [b]the world around continues to work on the real-time system[/b]. Enemies patrolling nearby can join the action if they get within range, so it can turn simple situations into really complicated fights, depending on the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/8de9dba5c16ca87f0a0be357a36f6b570d73afed.png[/img]

After this description, we hope you fancy a little skirmish. That's why we invite you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/zoria_age_of_shattering/]test our free demo[/url] and share any feedback you have.

Until the next one!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Let's talk about the Stats!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!👋

Today we want to talk about some [b]stats, armor, and attack types[/b] in Zoria. There are a lot of mechanics in the game that we believe we should cover, so you get the idea of what to expect when you jump into the world of Zoria. It's going to be a pretty long diary today, so grab your favorite beverage, snacks and enjoy the guide!

[b]Main Stats[/b]
These stats directly influence the character’s various attributes (health, damage) and the power of a character’s abilities.

 [list]
[*][i]Stamina:[/i] directly affects the character’s health. Especially important early game and the single greatest contributor to player survivability. 
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Strength:[/i] especially important for melee characters, directly affects Melee Attack Power and increases the Energy pool for Lancer class and Captain. It also increases block power for characters wearing a Shield.
[/list]

[*][i]Agility:[/i] increases Ranged Attack Power for Ranger. Increases Melee Attack Power for Thief. Increases Melee Attack Power for Lancer, Kingsman, Battle Cleric, and Captain to a smaller degree. notes.title: Devlog: Crafting
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers of Zoria,

Today is the turn of the Crafting System to receive a thorough presentation. The crafting system is part of the Outpost base and follower management System, but since it is almost complete and ready to go into closed beta testing, we decided to introduce it before the overall presentation of the Outpost.
Crafting in Zoria: Age of Shattering revolves around 2 key elements – recipes and player’s freedom to experiment and optimize.

[b]The Crafting Screen:[/b]
[list]
[*] The screen is split in 3 parts:
[*] Available recipes on the left side
[*] Inventory with all the available materials and crafting items on the right side
[*] The crafting area in the center.
[/list]

Once a recipe is selected, that item’s characteristics, bases stats and requirements appear in the crafting area. Each requirement slot must be filled with the specified number of materials (e.g. 2 crystal slots, 1 metal slots).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/5f09bec8342f81acac27dfda2d06ae4554e81e1e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] The item’s stats change according to the materials used to fill the slots, the complete stats being visible in the upper part of the central screen.
[*] The lower part of the central screen is where the special slots are located: the Crafting Kit slot and the Unstable Slot.
[*] Below them there is the item’s cost to craft and the Crafting Chance, that will remain 100% as long as no material is added to the Unstable Slot.
[/list]


[b]Recipes:[/b]
In order to craft any item, Armor, Weapon or Trinket, a recipe is necessary. These recipes can be acquired in a number of ways:
[list]
[*] Exploration – either on the main area map or exploring dungeons and hidden places.
[*] Quest rewards – by performing certain tasks and doing various quests.
[*] Missions – by sending characters on unattended missions that reward recipes.
[/list]

Recipes, just like the items they help craft, are grouped by rarity:
[list]
[*] Common
[*] Uncommon
[*] Rare
[*] Exotic
[*] Epic
[/list]

Each recipe allows the player to craft a certain item: Armor, Weapon or Trinket, of the recipe’s rarity.

All recipes have the following:
[list]
[*] Item Level.
[*] Item Type: Armor, Weapon, Trinket
[*] Base Stats – 1 to 3 base stats, specific to the recipe, depending on item rarity.
[*] Item Durability.
[*] Crafting Kit slot. 
[*] Crafting slots, number depending on rarity.
[*] Unstable Slot.
[/list]

[b]Item Level:[/b]
[list]
[*]Each recipe can craft an item of a certain level, its base stats depending on this level as much as the recipe’s rarity.
[/list] 

[b]Item Type:[/b]
[list]
[*] For Armors – Armor Type – light, medium, hardened, heavy
[*] For Weapons – Weapon Type – sword, axe, dagger, …
[/list]

[b]Base stats, depending on item types:[/b]
[list]
[*] Armors can have 1-3 Main Stats, depending on rarity - Stamina, Strength, Agility, Intellect.
[*] Weapons can have 1-3 Main or Secondary Stats, depending on rarity. 
[*] Shields can have 1-3 Main Stats, depending on rarity and also have a Block Chance Stat.
[*] Trinkets can have 1-3 Secondary Stats, depending on rarity.
[/list]

These stats are fixed for each recipe and will add their values to the custom slots of the recipe.

[b]Item Durability:[/b]
[list]
[*] All items have a base durability. This base durability is based on the Common Crafting Kit.
[*] The items durability can be improved by using better Crafting Kits.
[/list]

[b]Crafting Kit Slot[/b]
[list] 
[*] Crafting Kits are the base of any item to be crafted. 
[*] The Common Crafting Kit can be used to craft any item, either weapon or armor, and it comes with a base Durability value. 
[*] Other Crafting Kits can be used to craft specific items of 	greater durability – Uncommon, Rare and Exotic Crafting Kits provide greater durability for the crafted item, but they are specific to an item type.
[*] The type of Crafting Kit used is entirely at the player’s discretion, there are no limitations within the recipes.
[/list]

[b]Freedom to experiment and optimize:[/b]

The Crafting Slots and Unstable Slot together allow the player to experiment and craft a number of different items based on the same recipe, depending on the materials used. 

[b]Crafting Slots[/b]

[list]
[*] There are 2-5 crafting slots for a recipe, depending on rarity.
[*] Each Crafting Slot has a Material Type and a quantity – e.g. For a common item, the recipe can have the following slots: 2x Metal and 3x Fabric
[*] For an item to be crafted, all required slots must be completed.
[*] An item will be successfully crafted using any materials of the type and quantity specified in the Recipe: Metals, Fabrics or Crystals.
[*] Each material provides a different stat allowing the player to experiment and create different items starting from the same recipe.
[*] Completing all Crafting Slots with the appropriate materials results in 100% chance to craft that item.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/4e785616fbdb38a5506b6acb1170b4475b5d26bb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/66c37ee0da0453e596ee0560f2427c2842286b56.jpg[/img]

[b]Unstable Slot[/b]
This is the true wildcard of the crafting system, allowing the player greater freedom in crafting but bringing along greater risk in the crafting process.

[list]
[*] Additional to the normal Crafting Slots, that provide 100% chance to craft the item, all recipes also include an unstable slot.
[*] This unstable slot is completely optional, filling it is not required to craft an item.
[*] The Unstable Slot is the only slot where Fragments can be placed, a special type of crafting material, that provide enhanced stats.
[*] The Unstable Slot allows the player to craft more powerful items but with the added risk of the item’s chance to be successfully crafted decreasing.
[*] For each item placed in the Unstable Slot, the chance to craft decreases by 15% and the item durability decreases by 3%.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/a421b46660a4e3ea7080776314f076e900c59088.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The Blacksmith:[/b]
Being part of the Outpost facilities, crafting is accessible through the Blacksmith and uses the Outpost inventory, where all the materials accumulated during the player’s adventures are located.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/5af1e4df439b0880850bab34704c96b0b539cfcf.png[/img]
 
As with most of the buildings in the Outpost, the Blacksmith can be upgraded, providing access to more recipes or other bonuses. More about the Outpost and the upgrade system in a future Devlog.

With crafting is almost in testing phase, Alchemy and Cooking are already in development and they will be the subject of our next Devlog, followed by the other systems that make up the Outpost. 

If you enjoyed the Prologue and want to follow the game’s development, come and follow the Main Game's page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/


If you want to join the conversation, you can join our Discord:
 
[url=discord.zoriagame.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/19d7859b4b198674e9889887d5720324d8ae3470.jpg[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 coming June 29th
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers of Zoria,

With all the great feedback we have received from you following the Prologue launch, we now have ready an update that introduces a number of changes and additions to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other issues and requests.

[b]This update will go live Monday, 8AM PDT. [/b]

Unfortunately, due to the extensive interventions we have made on the game, [b]the existing saves are not compatible with this update[/b]. We are aware this might be unpleasant for a number of players but, weighting the pros and cons we think it’s better to make all these updates available to everyone.

This incompatibility is due to extensive changes made to the database and the interactions system powering the game.

Below a list of the major updates and fixes:

[b]Updated Combat UI:[/b] a consistent update to the combat UI, with far more information for the player: Line of Sight indicators for all enemies in range when moving to a new position, on the ground indicators for motion range and AP consumed, available abilities when moving to a new position and many more small improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/cb7704cfbe9f015f3244f1a807b607bb8de6bf44.png[/img] 

•	Hovering the mouse over the battlefield will show the Action Points consumed for moving to that position and the enemies in line of sight from that position.
•	The abilities shown above each enemy will be grayed out if the character will not have enough resources to use them once in position.
•	Hovering the mouse over the character will show the enemies in line of sight from the current position and the abilities available to use. The abilities can be selected either with the mouse or with the number keys 1-9.
Based on feedback we also implemented click-to-move by default and also, clicking on an enemy that is in range will attack that enemy with the default attack.

[b]Formations:[/b] Another very popular request, formations are now fully implemented in the game. There are 4 fixed formations and 3 completely custom formations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/e88eec02454f333f042444374ff19f6753ad3044.png[/img]

In the formations screen, the Captain is always in the center, as a fixed position. 
For the fixed formations, the followers can be distributed in the available slots, but the slots are fixed.
For the custom formations, all the slots except the Captain slot can be moved freely, allowing the player to make any kind of setup desired. 
 
[b]Updated Compendium:[/b] Improve Bestiary, with a more granular representation of all the enemies encountered in-game. After the first combat with a new enemy, the information is unlocked in the bestiary part of the Compendium, with some lore about that type of enemy and important data about fighting that enemy – Strengths (physical, magical resistances), Weaknesses and Threat level.
All enemies encountered in the game are now represented in the Compendium.

[b]Fixed multiple issues in quest-design:[/b] we have fixed a number of quest events that in certain edge case situations would not trigger properly. 

[b]Fixed multiple UI issues:[/b] we have made small changes to the UI based on existing feedback, fixed a few minor bugs and made some small changes to improve readability.

[b]Text edits and fixes:[/b] we fixed some typos that managed to escape proofreading in the previous builds.

[b]Encounters balancing:[/b] we have decided to take another look at the Guardian encounter and balance the fight to be more accessible and fix some unavoidable damage that could one-shot a follower. Since difficulty levels are not yet implemented, we have rebalanced this fight to be more accessible to players of all skill levels, allowing everyone to see the entire Prologue.

With all this said, there is still much feedback from you that is being worked, together with the rest of the systems still to be introduced to the game - Crafting, Alchemy, Cooking and the whole Outpost base and followers management system.


If you enjoy this Prologue, come follow us here:

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 is now LIVE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We want to thank you all for the awesome feedback we received in these past few days. Based on this feedback we implemented a number of changes to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other small issues that could be fixed in a timely manner.

[list]
[*] Adjusted Captain’s resistance to poison to prevent him from being destroyed by the spiders in the caves.
[*] “New skill points” display error on level up has been fixed. Now properly displays “New stat points”.
[*] A few spelling errors than went undiscovered during testing have now been fixed .
[*] Some quest dialogues that were not as clear as we would have liked them to have been adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue with the order in which the enemies were entering a combat, causing them to be higher up in queue than designed.
[*] The special resource used by the followers has been unified under one name: Focus.
[*] Followers keep basic movement formation when entering the combat. More formations options will be implemented later.
[*] Anya/Emonora higher starting level (3/4) to make the experience in the dungeon more enjoyable.
[*] Fixed Area-of-Effect targeting for some enemies.
[*] Updated Health Bar UI to green for friendly and red for enemy units.
[*] Fixed chest pickups not opening sometimes when the player was too close to them.
[/list]

Some changes on this list are only visible with a New Game, because of the way saving works.

More changes are coming, and we did not forget about the local map, we're working to bring that as soon as possible.
There are many more things that were pointed out to us in your feedback, some take more time to implement or are downright design issues that will take some time to be ironed out, but we are taking everything into account, so expect more changes in the future.
